title: Repeat Delivery Failures and Marlowe Rewards Goodwill
content:
A Marlowe Rewards service goodwill grant carries a repeat-failure uplift. It is set by the member's recent compensation history under Delivery Claims.

## The count

The count is the number of compensation entries booked on the member's delivery claims within the 12 months ending on the posting date. Compensation is booked when a claim's history shows compensation issued. An entry dated exactly 12 months before the posting date does not count.

## The uplift

| Compensation entries in the 12 months | Repeat-failure uplift |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 30 percent |
| exactly 2 | 15 percent |
| 1 or none | none |

## How the uplift acts

The uplift is a percentage of the grant's starting figure. It is added to the grant before the grant is rounded and limited. It is not rounded on its own.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical posting date of 20 September 2025)

| Compensation entries dated | Count | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| 21 September 2024, 3 March 2025, 2 August 2025 | 3 | 30 percent |
| 20 September 2024, 3 March 2025, 2 August 2025 | 2 (the 20 September 2024 entry does not count) | 15 percent |
| 3 March 2025 | 1 | none |

On a hypothetical starting figure of 150 points, 30 percent adds 45 points and 15 percent adds 22.5 points.
